Note 2 (ticket 1):

  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)

Contractors max out at read unless they have advanced training (never admin), so her maximum access is read. The requested level (admin) exceeds the maximum, so the maximum is granted: read.

content.text:
Let me work through this ticket.

Employee E033 (Jennifer Martin) requests admin access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- Note 1 (HR): role Analyst, full_time, recommendation write. Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist role, so full-time Analyst max = write.
- Note 2 (Security): role Analyst (not looked up), employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Security DB authoritative here. Contractors with basic training max out at read; never admin.

Conflict: HR says full_time, Security says contractor. Security note says security record is authoritative for employment type. Security training basic. Contractors max: read or write if advanced training. Basic training → read max. Never admin.

So the maximum for E033 is read (per contractor with basic training). Requested admin > max, so grant maximum = read.

I'll submit decision: read.
